REMIT.title: REMIT
REMIT.description: EU wholesale energy market regulation (REMIT): Regulation 1227/2011 as amended by REMIT II, Implementing Regulation 2026/256 and Delegated Regulation 2026/255, ACER guidance, guidance notes and Q&As, and ACER's reporting manuals (TRUM, MoP, exposure guidance). Search in plain language or by citation, articles returned with the ACER guidance that interprets them, application timeline 2024-2028, sources checked daily. Read-only, no auth.
